data.long_meaning: Lurlene is a name of Old English origin meaning 'Light from the sea'. It may have been derived from the Old English 'hlyro' meaning 'bright' and 'runa' meaning 'secret' or 'mystery'. This name carries a sense of mystery and enchantment, evoking images of the shimmering sea and the hidden treasures it may hold. The name Lurlene carries the meaning “Light from the sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Lurlene usually hope their child will grow to embody light from the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
